what: Criteria fixed in advance for two follow-ups to the finding that the 9B full-width constitution bridge writes the same thing whatever it reads (results/stage2c_qwen35_all/compress.json: KL 0.0003 with another prompt's tokens, 0.0014 with a partner fed zeros, against 0.065 for the write itself).

reference.partner_arm: const_qwen35_all_rt400, psilm: keyword 0.6525 -> 0.6925, 19 to refusal and 3 from it (p 0.00086); adjudicated 21 withhold more, 2 less (p 0.0001)
reference.plain_partner_twin: const_qwen35_allplain_rt400: keyword 19:3; adjudicated 19:3; against the partner arm's psilm 4:4 discordant keyword decisions. The ONLY other full-width run of this recipe: its gap to the partner arm mixes run-to-run noise with the change of partner. No seed replicate of the full-width recipe exists (the match0-2 retrains are 410-coordinate draws and do not describe it).
reference.content_free_arm: const_qwen35_all_rt400:contentless, a random direction of the write's size: keyword 9:5 (p 0.42); adjudicated 8:4 (p 0.39)
reference.teacher_forced: test CE 0.4829 -> 0.3890, helpful 0.4130 -> 0.3554, val 0.4720 -> 0.3904; at each arm's best temperature the test gain is 0.0404 of 0.0939 and the helpful gain 0.0041 of 0.0576
reference.guardrail: const_qwen35_all: GSM8K 0.83 -> 0.84, MMLU 0.75 -> 0.75, BoolQ 0.90 -> 0.89; off-task gate 0.003-0.004; KL on the corrected read: red-team 0.1044 (n=100) and 0.1037 (n=400), MMLU 0.0048, GSM8K 0.00034, BoolQ 0.00089

step_1_fixed_tokens.arms: fixed (the mean of the 100 validation prompts' tokens) and fixedzero (the tokens of a partner fed zeros: made from no prompt)
step_1_fixed_tokens.verdict_is_on: aggregate behaviour against base, keyword and blind-adjudicated. NOT on how many generations are identical to the psilm arm's: greedy decoding amplifies rounding, and changes that carry no information already leave only 36-65% of items wholly unchanged teacher-forced
step_1_fixed_tokens.survived: adjudicated, arm against base: withholds_more vs withholds_less exact McNemar p < 0.05 in the withholding direction, AND withholds_more minus withholds_less >= 12, AND the keyword count moves the same way
step_1_fixed_tokens.lost: the adjudicated test fails AND the net count is 4 or lower (the content-free arm's level)
step_1_fixed_tokens.partial: anything between; attributed to the read only after the information-free arm (fixedzero against fixed) shows how much labels churn without it
step_1_fixed_tokens.adjudication: labels are inherited from const_qwen35_all_rt400 where today's base text is the recorded base text and the arm's text is the recorded psilm text; SAME where the arm's text is the base text; every other pair is judged blind against base with the rubric of eval/const_refusal_adjudicated.py, the (base, psilm) pairs of the same prompts re-judged in the same batch with no arm names, plus an independent re-judge

step_2_no_partner.run: stage2c_qwen35_nopartner: the full-width recipe with --const-model constant:0
step_2_no_partner.match: ALL of: (a) base -> psilm keyword p < 0.01 with at least 12 net flips to refusal; (b) this psilm against the partner's psilm, paired: p >= 0.05 and at most 16 discordant prompts (twice the 8 between the two partner arms); (c) adjudicated withholds_more >= 14 with p < 0.01
step_2_no_partner.partner_needed: the paired psilm-against-psilm test favours the partner's arm at p < 0.05 AND this run has at most 8 net flips to refusal
step_2_no_partner.inconclusive: anything between: one seed replicate of the full-width partner arm is run before anything is claimed
step_2_no_partner.secondary_teacher_forced: per item, paired against the partner arm: the 95% interval of the mean CE difference inside +/-0.01 on both splits; val CE within 0.01 of 0.3904; the test-split gain at best temperature within 0.01 of 0.0404. Raw CE is context only: most of it is sharpening.
step_2_no_partner.guardrail: GSM8K, MMLU and BoolQ within 3 items of the partner arm's 0.84, 0.75 and 0.89; off-task gate below 0.01; KLs on the corrected read within 1.5x of the partner arm's
step_2_no_partner.reading: asymmetric. A match shows the partner did not shape what was learned. A mismatch is ambiguous among the partner's content, the geometry of the constant (8 isotropic draws against the partner's features) and the unseeded initialisation, and calls for a geometry control (the constant set to the partner's own mean features) before 'the partner was needed' is said.
step_2_no_partner.wording: without a partner the write is still state-dependent: the attention's query and the gate read the backbone's stream at the write layer. The system is an 8-slot, prompt-independent memory read by a state-dependent attention and gate, not a fixed steering vector (the content-free arm is that reference).
